description_en: The unseen demo mill, replayed hour by hour; Press 2 worm wear develops.
description_ms: Kilang demo yang tidak dilihat, dimainkan jam demi jam; kehausan worm Penekan 2 berkembang.

description_en: Mill 10 with a bearing failing on Press 3 about 100 running hours after the start.
description_ms: Kilang 10 dengan bearing Penekan 3 rosak kira-kira 100 jam larian selepas permulaan.

description_en: Press 4 vibration sensor sticks, then spikes. No machine fault: expect a sensor alert, not a machine alert.
description_ms: Penderia getaran Penekan 4 tersekat, kemudian melonjak. Tiada kerosakan mesin: jangkakan amaran penderia, bukan amaran mesin.
